description:
Weekly public aggregate of demand: what callers asked this API for that it
did not have or rejected (ghost routes, rejected arguments, ghost MCP tools, tools/list counts). One ISO week, Monday 00:00 UTC to the next Monday
00:00 UTC (`?week=` picks the week containing a date; default is the current
week). Aggregate rows only: a row is published only when at least
`n_threshold` (3) distinct actors produced it in the window. Rows below that
are omitted, and their count is published in `suppressed` ({rows, events}).
No actor identifier, IP, raw path, query string, timestamp or per-row user
agent is ever returned. `name` and `path_shape` are caller-supplied request
text, marked `caller_supplied: true`; they are not TunnelMind statements.
`valid_until` equals `window_end`. Add `?receipt=true` for a signed Receipt
v1.0 over the same payload.
Totals cover published rows only. `ghost_tool_per_list_ratio` is ghost tool
asks per tools/list, because only unknown-tool calls are recorded.

receipt.description: When true, attach a signed Receipt v1.0 committed to the transparency log. Additive — a signing failure never costs you the observation (ADR-014).

week.description: Any date (YYYY-MM-DD) inside the wanted ISO week. Defaults to the current week.

name: get_demand_aggregate
